restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.body: Replace everything in this Bayplan with the contents of a backup file.

summary.title: What's in this backup
summary.older: This backup is from an older Bayplan and is upgraded while restoring.
summary.publicUrlDiffers: This isn't the address you're using now. After you sign in, check Settings → General, or set BAYPLAN_PUBLIC_URL.

confirm.title: Restore this backup?
confirm.body: This replaces all users, teams, access, settings, environments and audit entries in this Bayplan with the backup's. Everyone is signed out, including you. Bayplan saves a snapshot first, so you can go back.

errors.unreadable: Couldn't open this backup. Check the passphrase, and that the file isn't damaged.
errors.newer: This backup is from a newer Bayplan ({{version}}). Upgrade this Bayplan, then try again.
errors.newerUnnamed: This backup is from a newer Bayplan. Upgrade this Bayplan, then try again.
errors.notABackup: That isn't a Bayplan backup file.
errors.cutOff: The upload was cut off. If Bayplan runs behind a reverse proxy, check its upload size limit.
errors.busy: Another restore is being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.check: Couldn't check this backup. Check the container logs, then try again.

failed.nothingChanged: The restore didn't finish and nothing was changed.
failed.rolledBack: The restore failed and Bayplan went back to the snapshot.
failed.timeout: Bayplan hasn't come back yet. Reload this page in a minute. If it doesn't load, check the container logs.

overlay.title: Restoring…
overlay.body: Don't close this page. This takes a moment.

done.heading: Backup restored
done.body: You were signed out. Sign in with an account from the backup.
done.agents: Agents reconnect on their own once your public URL points at this Bayplan. Agents installed after the backup was taken are listed under Settings → Environments.
done.notice: Backup restored. Sign in with an account from the backup.
